question: Should routine restart-required `config.patch`/`config.apply` writes in hot mode continue to direct-restart as on current main, or change to watcher-style warn-and-keep?
rationale: This compatibility change is separable from the reported watched-file staleness fix, and either outcome changes established operator expectations and application timing.

options.title: Preserve current RPC restarts
options.body: Keep direct restart for routine restart-required RPC writes and limit this PR to narrowly proven security-critical watcher behavior.

options.title: Unify with watcher behavior
options.body: Return `requiresRestart` without restarting for routine hot-mode RPC writes and document the new required operator action.

recommendation.title: Preserve current RPC restarts
recommendation.body: Keep direct restart for routine restart-required RPC writes and limit this PR to narrowly proven security-critical watcher behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main gateway reload and restart-sequencing history makes this the strongest available owner for the compatibility decision.
